desc: Prove the structural characterization: selected Operation 2 actions leave the intersection of their original intervals uncovered, and an optimum needs at most two Operation 2 actions.
Establish the cost-at-most-3 theorem and characterize cost-1 and all cost-2 solution types.
Fix mixed cost-2 reconstruction tie-breaking to produce the required canonical sample construction.
Rerun sample tests after the reconstruction fix and validate edge cases: impossibility, full-range intervals, singleton intervals, duplicate intervals, and complement-only configurations.
Provide a proof of reconstruction correctness, optimality, and O(M log M) complexity.
